title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Platform Software Development:**

* Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use.
* Perform deep debugging across a limited-service graph; drive compatibility-safe remediation plans.
* Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers.

**Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:**

* Designs software solutions and analyzes and helps identify requirements to achieve business and operational goals, independently.
* Adheres to and suggests improvements to all phases of the software development lifecycle.
* Utilizes working knowledge to develop new software features and enhancements following design specifications and develops documents to clarify software design and code.
* Leads code reviews in designated areas to help drive improvements.
* Conducts debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix moderately complex software issues. Develops fixes for identified issues.
* Implements software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional testing), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging, ensuring review by manager and/or lead throughout the process.
* Exercises judgment and discretion to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding.
* Troubleshoots and resolves moderately complex issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.
* Implements moderately complex API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

**Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:**

* Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture.
* Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices.
* Collaborates with team leads to review work to ensure alignment with software architecture.
* Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.

**Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:**

* Collaborates within and beyond immediate team to understand customer issues and align solutions.
* May provide technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer-reported issues, independently.
* Coaches, mentors, and guides others to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.
* Influences team to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.
* Implements customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes, independently.
* Investigates and troubleshoots complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions (e.g., future enhancements).

**Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:**

* Collaborates with the team to establish and follow development practices and coding standards.
* Exercises judgment and discretion to ensure code quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development.
* Keeps up to date with industry best practices and applies them to software development processes.
* Implements secure coding practices to prevent security vulnerabilities.

**Development Operations - System Maintenance:**

* Performs periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).
* Exercises judgment and discretion to drive improvements, ensure automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

**Core Responsibilities**
**Planning & Execution:**

* Independently manages work, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure projects or initiatives stay on track and meet requirements. Proactively prioritizes work and adapts to resource or timeline shifts, suggesting adjustments to maintain project efficiency.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others.

**Problem Solving:**

* Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

* Drive consensus when confronted with discordant views by identifying the best path forward and influence other to follow it.

Since its founding in 2013, Ring has been on a mission to make neighborhoods safer, together for everyone. **Preferred Qualifications**

description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
  
  
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**Company Description**

Okta is the leading independent provider of enterprise identity. The Okta Identity Cloud enables organizations to securely connect the right people to the right technologies at the right time. With over 6,500 pre-built integrations to applications and infrastructure providers, Okta customers can easily and securely use the best technologies for their business. Over 7,950 organizations, including 20th Century Fox, JetBlue, Nordstrom, Slack, Teach for America, and Twilio, trust Okta to help protect the identities of their workforces and customers.

**Position Description**

We are seeking an experienced
**Senior Software Engineer**
to play a key role in building and scaling the
**Okta Recovery Vault (ORV)**
. This team is responsible for Okta's enterprise-grade soft-delete and object recovery capability, designed to protect critical identity objects (Users and Groups) from accidental or malicious deletion.

As a Senior Engineer, you will own the technical design, implementation, and operational reliability of critical components within our real-time, high-fidelity recovery system. You will solve complex engineering problems around identity preservation (UUIDs) and relationship restoration—including group memberships, app assignments, and password hashes—ensuring our customers can seamlessly recover from data loss events.

* Support telescopic bridge positioning and cleaner transfer operations.

* Conduct field trials at solar power plants.
* Debug navigation, localization and sensor issues.

B.Tech / B.E. in Robotics, Mechatronics, Electronics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.

description:

Governance, Leadership & Delivery

* Engage with stakeholders to run workshops, clarify requirements, define solution roadmaps, and support implementation planning.

* Discovery

* Event Management
* CMDB
* Orchestration / Automation \\* Deep understanding of CSDM and service modeling principles in ServiceNow.
* Solid experience with CMDB architecture , CI relationships, reconciliation, identification rules, and governance. \\* Experience aligning ServiceNow implementation with Enterprise Architecture , business capability models, and application/service portfolios.
* Strong development experience using JavaScript, Glide API, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub , and standard ServiceNow customization techniques. \\* Experience in hybrid/cloud environments and enterprise integrations.

description:
**Description**
Role Overview
  
  
As an L6 Software Development Manager in AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain, you will define the strategic vision for your team, establish a roadmap, and successfully deliver software that powers one of the world's largest and most complex physical infrastructure supply chains. You will independently manage a team of SDEs building large-scale distributed systems that enable AWS to procure, manufacture, ship, and deploy hundreds of thousands of server and network racks into data centers globally across AMER, EMEA, APAC, and GOVT regions.
  
  
Strategic Ownership
  
  
Define the strategic vision for your team, partnering effectively with customers and stakeholders across the supply chain lifecycle — from demand planning and material supportability to manufacturing, logistics, and DC deployment.
  
  
Establish a roadmap and successfully deliver software that executes that vision, aligned with the end-to-end supply chain needs spanning systems like S&OP POR, RP3, Build Planner, Fulfillment Planner, and the Infrastructure Control Tower.
  
  
Make crisp, independent decisions about what projects move forward and in what priority order, balancing competing priorities across demand forecasting, capacity planning, fulfillment optimization, and observability.
  
  
Write narratives, PR/FAQs, and other strategic documentation to drive alignment and decision-making.
  
  
Technical Domain
  
  
Your team will work on one or more of the following areas:
  
  
Real-time observability platforms — powering the Infrastructure Control Tower that tracks 100K+ active demands through stage progression, dwell times, blocker reason codes, and checkpoint milestones.
  
  
AI/ML-driven forecasting — demand planning, ETA prediction, and supply-demand matching across 130+ component categories and 1,400+ Superset Fungibility Groups (SFGs).
  
  
Optimization engines — capacity planning systems that match server/network demand (converted to kW) against DC power supply at lineup, breaker, site, and meter-site levels.
  
  
Multi-agent orchestration systems — coordinating fulfillment across vendors, manufacturing sites, and DC positions in priority order (ML → Network → Non-ML).
  
  
Data pipelines — processing millions of events daily across the fulfillment pipeline from Purchase Request through to Handoff.
  
  
People Leadership
  
  
Independently manage a team of SDEs; hire the right mix of engineers to accomplish team goals.
  
  
Assess SDE performance effectively; manage both high and low performers and take effective action addressing employee concerns.
  
  
Hire, develop, and promote SDEs, delegating appropriately based on the strength and development objectives of individuals on your team.
  
  
Build an effective development process that consistently delivers software with minimal defects and system disruption.
  
  
Customer & Operational Excellence
  
  
Define metrics to measure customer experience, team development progress, and operational excellence across the supply chain systems your team owns.
  
  
Establish customer engagement mechanisms to stay connected to the needs of internal customers — service teams (EC2, S3, EBS), supply planners, manufacturing partners, and logistics operators.
  
  
Ensure your team adheres to SLAs and effectively manages software operations.
  
  
Proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your manager, customers, and stakeholders with mitigation plans before they become roadblocks. Know when to escalate to Senior Leaders.
  
  
Deliver Results
  
  
Consistently deliver software with minimal defects and system disruption.
  
  
Improve the quality of software owned by your team and operational performance metrics under your leadership.
  
  
Communicate ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing, to all types of audiences — from engineering peers to senior leadership.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Strategic Vision & Roadmap
  
  
Define the strategic vision for your team within the supply chain domain — whether that's demand planning, fulfillment optimization, manufacturing observability, or capacity planning
  
  
Establish and execute a roadmap that aligns with the end-to-end supply chain lifecycle, translating business needs into engineering deliverables
  
  
Make crisp, independent decisions about project prioritization, balancing competing demands across systems like RP3, Fulfillment Planner, Build Planner, and Control Tower
  
  
Author narratives, PR/FAQs, and strategic documents to drive alignment with leadership and stakeholders
  
  
Technical Delivery & Operational Excellence
  
  
Deliver high-quality software consistently with minimal defects and system disruption across large-scale distributed systems processing millions of events daily
  
  
Manage software operations effectively — ensuring uptime, reliability, and performance for systems tracking 100K+ active demands
  
  
Define and monitor metrics for team development progress, customer experience, and operational excellence (e.g., stage dwell times, on-track/off-track KPIs, manufacturing output trends)
  
  
Drive continuous improvement — improve software quality and operational performance metrics under your leadership
  
  
People Management & Development
  
  
Independently manage a team of SDEs — hire the right mix of engineers to accomplish team goals
  
  
Assess SDE performance and manage both high and low performers with effective action
  
  
Hire, develop, and promote SDEs — build a talent pipeline and export talent across the organization
  
  
Delegate appropriately — assign tasks based on individual strengths and development objectives, stretching engineers into areas like AI/ML forecasting, optimization engines, and real-time observability
  
  
Customer Engagement & Stakeholder Management
  
  
Partner effectively with customers and stakeholders — internal service teams (EC2, S3, EBS), supply planners, GSMs, manufacturing partners (Jabil, Foxconn, Quanta), and logistics operators
  
  
Establish customer engagement mechanisms to stay connected to evolving supply chain needs
  
  
Define metrics to measure customer experience across the fulfillment pipeline — from Purchase Request through Handoff
  
  
Risk Management & Escalation
  
  
Proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your manager, customers, and stakeholders with mitigation plans before they become roadblocks
  
  
Know when to escalate to Senior Leaders — especially critical in a domain where delays in manufacturing, material shortages, or DC readiness issues can cascade across the global fleet
  
  
Ensure your team adheres to SLAs across all systems and operational commitments
  
  
Culture & Process
  
  
Build an effective development process that enables sustainable, high-quality delivery
  
  
Use mechanisms, not good intentions — establish trust-and-verify systems for operational excellence, code quality, and team health
  
  
Drive root cause analysis — instill a culture of asking "5 whys," fixing to root cause, and adding missing metrics after incidents

**About The Business Function**
CTI-MD enable the digital capabilities that power Lilly's clinical development and patient safety ecosystem. We build connected trial platforms, AI-driven solutions, and data products that support study design, trial execution, clinical insights, and pharmacovigilance. Our teams help ensure patient safety through the collection, assessment, monitoring, and reporting of safety data while accelerating the development of life-changing medicines. By combining clinical expertise with engineering excellence, we improve patient and site experiences, strengthen regulatory compliance, and drive innovation across the development lifecycle.
  
  
**Role**
The Sr. System Architect, Global Patient Safety operates at the intersection of business context, product management, engineering, data, AI, and enterprise architecture for the GPS portfolio — accountable for technology strategy, architecture direction, and measurable business outcomes across Pharmacovigilance. This role is split 70% hands-on technical execution including coding and 30% strategy, and shapes the future technology landscape. The role balances delivery needs with long-term vision for scalable, secure, compliant, and maintainable solutions; drives transformation and future-state platforms; mentors technical leaders; and represents GPS as a global partner in enterprise architecture decision-making — bridging business stakeholders, vendors, and technical teams while building a durable architecture capability inside Lilly. Operates at the senior system architect level, engaging across the enterprise — including Enterprise Architecture — and providing technical leadership across the full solution lifecycle, from design through implementation
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Portfolio Architecture Ownership — own end-to-end technical architecture across the Safety ecosystem (Case Management, Signals, Reporting) and connected Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, and Data systems; set portfolio-level architecture roadmaps and standards, preparing decisions ahead of delivery rather than resolving them reactively. Understands the pharmacovigilance system, its business context, and adjacent platforms shaping upstream/downstream decisions.
* AI / Agentic Architecture Enablement — convert emerging AI/agentic use cases into reusable, governed architecture patterns, translating proofs-of-concept into production-ready solutions that scale across the portfolio; partner with AI, engineering, and vendor teams to embed AI/agentic components responsibly within safety architecture and compliance guardrails. Requires deep, broad technology knowledge — cloud-native services, data products, and responsible-AI controls.
* Governance, Risk & GxP Compliance — embed audit-readiness and change-control thinking into architecture patterns, ensuring compliance with FDA/EMA and internal IT/quality policies; maintain architecture documentation in support of audit, inspection, and CSV readiness; evaluate technical debt in legacy Safety and Regulatory systems and shift governance upstream to reduce late-stage compliance issues. Leverages adjacent-system knowledge to drive robust business discussions and influence how GPS platforms evolve.
* Vendor Independence & Knowledge Retention — serve as the primary technical authority for architecture judgement, reducing reliance on vendors (e.g., Veeva, Qinesca, etc.), with delivery partners executing within Lilly-owned guardrails; act as the primary technical point of contact for vendor teams, leading design and configuration decisions that protect long-term design integrity.
* Product & Business Partnership — partner with Patient Safety, Quality, Regulatory, and IT stakeholders to translate business strategy into technology capabilities, articulating trade-offs and risks that inform prioritisation; participate in strategic planning and portfolio reviews as a trusted advisor to business and technology leadership. Challenges the status quo, recommending improvements to team processes, governance, and control patterns that drive innovation
* Global Leadership — represent GPS Tech in global architecture forums, building partnerships across global Patient Safety technology teams; drive shared ownership and accountability models between India and global organisations, promoting Lilly's product operating model principles across GPS. Actively promotes ideas and impacts decisions across multiple teams and capabilities — leading, global architecture direction.
* Decision-Making Authority — make strategic architecture recommendations and approve major solution and integration designs across the GPS portfolio; influence technology investment decisions and challenge product, engineering, or vendor approaches when architectural or compliance risks exist; recommend platform standardisation opportunities and escalate enterprise architectural or GxP concerns to leadership when necessary. Breaks down complex portfolio problems into decisions delivering broad business impact and measurable risk reduction.
* Talent Development & Technical Leadership — mentor engineering leads, building architecture capability through coaching and communities of practice; create a succession path for future GPS architecture leadership, with emphasis on growing technical talent, and contribute to hiring and talent planning; review and approve technical designs and configuration specifications for quality and compliance. Coaches through design reviews and communities of practice to broaden team impact.

**Qualifications Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred).
* 12+ years in IT/enterprise/portfolio architecture or senior technical leadership, including 4+ years supporting pharmacovigilance or patient safety technology and processes (case intake, triage, signal management, regulatory reporting).
* Demonstrated ownership of architecture decisions at a portfolio or platform level across multiple concurrent programmes.
* Proven experience designing, deploying, or governing AI/agentic solutions, scaling POCs into production architecture.
* Deep hands-on experience with Pharmacovigilance (Safety) and their integration with Quality, Regulatory, Clinical, and Data platforms.
* Strong command and hands-on experience with enterprise integration patterns (APIs, middleware, ETL, data mapping), cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure), and integration middleware & architecture development.

Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.
  
  
**Job Summary**
This job independently drives data analytics and business intelligence efforts, crafting predictive models and strategic insights for informed decision-making. It operates with minimal guidance, ensuring data integrity and compliance. The role effectively communicates complex data findings to influence executive-level strategies.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Job Description**

* Work with business leaders and stakeholders to understand data and analysis needs and develop technical requirements.
* Analyze large, complex data to determine actionable business insights using self-service analytics and reporting tools.
* Combines data as needed from disparate data sources to complete analysis from multiple sources.
* Identifies key business drivers and insights by conducting exploratory data analysis and hypothesis testing.
* Develops forecasting models to predict business key metrics.
* Develops LLM models to predict most complex and raw data more effectively.
* Communicates findings clearly and concisely through narrative-driven presentations and effective data visualizations to Company executives and decisionmakers.
* Stays current with emerging trends in analytics, statistics, machine learning and applies them to business challenges.

**Mandatory Skills**

* SQL
* Statistics concepts
* Good storytelling capabilities
* 5+ years of total IT experience

**Nice To Have Skills**

* PPT creation
* Databricks
* Spark
* LLM

Please visit the compensation and benefits summary on our careers site for more details.

Bachelor's Degree

7-10 Years

title: Head of Technology / VP Engineering
description:
**Hiring: Head of Technology / VP Engineering**

**Company:**
KGIL Fintech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (SwipeLoan)

**Location:**
Hinjawadi, Pune | Work from Office

**Experience:**
10–15+ years in Technology, Software Engineering, Architecture and Engineering Leadership

**CTC:**
₹18–24 LPA, depending on experience and technical expertise

**Reporting to:**
Founder & CEO

**About KGIL**

KGIL is building a diversified technology ecosystem with products spanning fintech, digital lending, credit solutions and emerging consumer internet businesses.

Through SwipeLoan and our expanding portfolio of digital platforms, we aim to develop and scale technology-driven businesses across multiple industries.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a highly experienced, hands-on technology leader with
**CTO-level capabilities**
who can take complete ownership of technology strategy, architecture, engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity and product development across our growing ecosystem.

This is not a conventional IT management role.

The selected candidate must be capable of independently evaluating new business concepts, selecting appropriate technology stacks, designing scalable systems, building engineering teams and delivering end-to-end technology solutions.

We are looking for a technology generalist with deep engineering expertise who is comfortable working across different programming languages, frameworks, architectures and business domains.

The candidate should have the technical judgment and leadership ability to build products using both existing and emerging technologies, without being restricted to any single programming language or framework.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Technology Ownership**

* Own the complete technology function across existing and future KGIL platforms.
* Define long-term technology strategy, architecture standards and engineering roadmaps.
* Independently translate business ideas into technical requirements, architecture and execution plans.
* Take responsibility for technology decisions from product conceptualisation to development, deployment, scaling and maintenance.
* Act as the primary technology advisor to the Founder & CEO.
* Evaluate technical feasibility, development timelines, resource requirements and infrastructure costs for new businesses.
* Ensure all platforms are secure, scalable, reliable and commercially efficient.

**2. Multi-Technology & Full-Stack Engineering Leadership**

Lead engineering across multiple technology stacks, including but not limited to:

* **Backend:**
  PHP, Laravel, Node.js, Python, Django, FastAPI, Java, Spring Boot, Go and other relevant technologies.
* **Frontend:**
  React.js, Next.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular and modern frontend frameworks.
* **Mobile Applications:**
  Flutter, React Native, native Android and iOS development.
* **Databases:**
  MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and other SQL/NoSQL technologies.
* **Cloud & Infrastructure:**
  AWS, cloud-native architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, serverless systems and CI/CD.
* **Integrations:**
  REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, third-party APIs, payment gateways and external services.
* **AI & Automation:**
  AI/ML integrations, LLM-based applications, intelligent automation and data-driven product capabilities.

The candidate is not expected to write production code in every language personally but must possess sufficient architectural and technical depth to evaluate, guide and manage engineering teams working across different technology stacks.

**3. New Product Development & Technology Expansion**

* Lead technology development for new businesses across fintech and non-fintech industries.
* Evaluate new product ideas and recommend the most suitable technology stack for each business.
* Design and deliver MVPs, scalable applications and enterprise-grade platforms.
* Lead development of consumer applications, marketplaces, subscription platforms, SaaS products, social networking applications and e-commerce solutions.
* Build reusable technology components, shared services and APIs wherever commercially appropriate.
* Evaluate build-versus-buy decisions, third-party platforms and outsourcing opportunities.
* Ensure new product launches meet defined timelines, budgets and quality standards.
* Support rapid experimentation, prototyping and product-market validation.

**4. Technology Architecture & Scalability**

* Design scalable, secure and high-performance application architectures.
* Make informed decisions between monolithic, modular and microservices architectures.
* Establish standards for API design, database architecture, system integrations and data management.
* Implement performance optimisation, caching, monitoring and system observability.
* Plan infrastructure capacity for high-volume applications and rapid user growth.
* Ensure appropriate system resilience, backup, disaster recovery and business continuity arrangements.
* Identify and resolve technical debt and architectural limitations.

**5. Engineering Team Leadership & Recruitment**

* Lead existing backend, frontend, mobile, QA, DevOps and AI/ML teams.
* Independently recruit developers, architects and technical specialists based on business requirements.
* Build and manage multiple engineering teams working on different products simultaneously.
* Establish clear reporting structures, engineering ownership and accountability.
* Define development standards, code review processes and technical documentation requirements.
* Conduct technical interviews and assess candidate capabilities across different technology stacks.
* Mentor engineering leads and develop future technology leaders.
* Manage internal development teams, freelancers, technology vendors and outsourced partners.

**6. DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure & Cybersecurity**

* Own cloud infrastructure, deployment pipelines, production environments and system monitoring.
* Manage AWS infrastructure and evaluate alternative cloud services where appropriate.
* Establish robust CI/CD, release management and automated testing processes.
* Implement cybersecurity controls, vulnerability management, access controls and secure development practices.
* Oversee incident response, disaster recovery and infrastructure reliability.
* Coordinate technical security requirements relating to ISO 27001, applicable data protection laws and regulatory obligations.
* Ensure company-controlled access to source code, repositories, servers, cloud accounts and technology assets.
* Monitor infrastructure expenditure and implement cost optimisation initiatives.

**7. Fintech & Third-Party Integrations**

* Oversee technology integrations with banks, NBFCs, credit bureaus, KYC providers, Account Aggregators, payment gateways and other financial technology service providers.
* Ensure reliability, security and performance of partner APIs.
* Support lending journeys, credit eligibility systems, subscription payments and automated financial workflows.
* Coordinate with business and compliance teams on technology-related regulatory requirements.

**8. Product, Business & Leadership Collaboration**

* Work closely with the Founder & CEO to evaluate and execute new business opportunities.
* Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Finance, Business Development and Operations teams.
* Provide technical recommendations in business planning and strategic discussions.
* Prepare technology budgets, development roadmaps and resource allocation plans.
* Communicate technical risks, dependencies and investment requirements clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
* Take independent ownership of technical execution while keeping management informed of major decisions.

**Candidate Requirements**

**Mandatory**

* 10–15+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 4–5 years in engineering leadership or architecture roles.
* Strong hands-on software engineering background with experience designing and scaling production applications.
* Demonstrated expertise across multiple backend, frontend and mobile technology ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of system architecture, cloud infrastructure, databases, APIs and cybersecurity.
* Experience independently building and launching digital products from concept to production.
* Proven ability to recruit, manage and scale multidisciplinary engineering teams.
* Ability to evaluate unfamiliar technologies and make sound architecture decisions.
* Strong problem-solving capabilities and technical decision-making skills.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent technology projects.
* Excellent communication, ownership and leadership capabilities.

**Highly Preferred**

* Previous experience as CTO, VP Engineering, Head of Engineering, Technology Director or Principal Architect.
* Experience in both fintech and non-fintech consumer technology businesses.
* Experience building products from zero to one and scaling established platforms.
* Experience with high-traffic consumer applications, marketplaces, subscriptions or SaaS products.
* Experience managing AI/ML projects and modern AI-enabled development workflows.

**Key Success Measures**

* Successful delivery of new digital products from concept to launch.
* Platform uptime, reliability, scalability and security.
* Timely completion of product and engineering roadmaps.
* Quality of technology architecture and engineering decisions.
* Reduction in production incidents and deployment failures.
* Engineering team productivity, capability development and retention.
* Effective technology hiring and resource utilisation.
* Cloud infrastructure and technology cost optimisation.
* Ability to independently manage multiple products and technology stacks.
* Reduced dependency on the Founder & CEO for day-to-day technical decisions.

**Who Should Apply?**

We are particularly interested in technology leaders who have:

* Built and scaled multiple technology products.
* Worked across different programming languages and frameworks.
* Led engineering teams in more than one technology domain.
* Designed complete software architectures independently.

**We are not looking for someone who knows only one technology stack or simply manages developers.**

**We are looking for a CTO-minded technology leader who can take a business idea, identify the right technology, build the right team and deliver a scalable product independently.**

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. As Test Engineer, the person will be responsible for the analyzing project requirements, preparing test plan, documenting test cases, documenting test cases execution, and documenting defects identified during test cases execution.
  
  
Test Engineer will closely work with development team to resolve defects identified during test cases execution and document defects closure.
  
  
Test Engineer will work to identify opportunities and implement test cases automation using selenium automated testing tools.
  
  
Test Engineer will adhere to established QA testing processes and participate in QA testing process improvements, QA checklists preparation, QA templates creation, Standard Works Creation, lesson learned and prior knowledge utilization to ensure that product has high quality standards and ready for production deployment.
  
  
Test Engineer will support our global HR organization, working as QA Test Engineer for HR/Payroll solutions and will report to EAS Quality Assurance Services Lead.
  
  
Test Engineer will work to deliver testing artifacts (deliverables) on time as per project schedules while working on high visibility projects. Test Engineer will also be responsible for working on various projects in parallel with prioritizing tasks as per respective project schedules.
  
  
Test Engineer has extensive knowledge of HR/Payroll domain, cloud-based HR/Payroll systems or Custom HR/Payroll web applications, Integrations, backend testing with SQL, PL/SQL, Oracle database, Schemas and schema objects, Toad for Oracle, SQL Developer, ADP Enterprise, Workday etc. Test Engineer also has good knowledge on HR/Payroll business processes like Hire, Job Change, Transfer, Leave of Absence, Time-Off, Terminations, Promotions, One Time Payment, Incentive and awards transaction processing, Benefits processing etc. There will be an opportunity to collaborate with the various teams and functions like HR, Payroll, Benefits, Compensation, Recruiting, Learning Management, and with various parts of the Digital Technology organization.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  
Test Engineer demonstrates knowledge in HR/Payroll domain, HR/Payroll business processes, functional, Integration and backend Testing.
  
  
Test Engineer demonstrates knowledge in testing cloud-based HR/Payroll systems or custom HR/Payroll web applications.
  
  
Test Engineer demonstrates proficiency in writing SQL, analyzing PL/SQL code and extensive knowledge in Oracle database and its schema objects, DBMS jobs, Linux Cron Jobs, Toad, SQL Developer, file processing, file compare, MS Excel, and backend testing using SQL queries.
  
  
Test Engineer has ability to analyze project requirements, prepare test plan, document test cases, test cases execution and defects in Jira.
  
  
Ability to work on testing tasks for multiple workstreams (e.g. HR, Payroll, Benefits) as well as multiple projects.
  
  
Partner with QA team in identifying opportunities and improvements, Participate in QA testing processes improvements.
  
  
Ability to create QA test cases template, checklists, standard works in Jira for frequent testing tasks.
  
  
Ability to communicate for QA testing and other tasks with teams within organization.
  
  
Participating in daily projects stand up meetings and report testing progress, work stoppers, defects and keep Jira up to date.
  
  
Comply Data privacy and Data security during testing processes.
  
  
Ability to work primarily remotely with occasional travel.
  
  
Required Skills and Qualifications:
  
  
Typically, a minimum of 6+ years of Quality Assurance experience and a bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of related work experience. Advanced degree and 4+ years related work experience.
  
  
Experience in HR/Payroll domain, HR/Payroll business processes like Hire, Job Change, Transfer, Leave of Absence, Time-Off, Terminations, Promotions, One Time Payment, Incentive and awards transaction processing etc.
  
  
Experience in testing cloud-based HR/Payroll systems or custom HR/Payroll web applications.
  
  
Experience in the software development life cycle including Requirements, analysis, design, development, testing and implementation of HR/Payroll solutions using ADP, Workday, and custom applications using .NET platform, VB.NET etc.
  
  
Experienced in creating and documenting Test strategy, Test plan, Test cases, Test data, Test execution, defects, test status report, and proficient in Testing Tools (e.g., Jira, Quality Center, Selenium).
  
  
Experience in integration and backend testing using SQL queries, analyzing PL/SQL code, Oracle database and its schema objects, DBMS jobs, Linux Cron Jobs, Toad, SQL Developer, File processing, File compare, File Transfer, MS Excel, Text Editor like Notepad++ etc.
  
  
Education:
  
  
Typically, a bachelor’s degree in computer science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) or related discipline.
